tools.name: highlight_create
tools.description: Create Thai highlight clips from one public YouTube URL. URL alone is enough; defaults auto-analyze and render. Returns job_id immediately. No API key argument. Poll status; do not resubmit to check progress.

tools.name: highlight_status
tools.description: Read durable job status without invoking paid analysis. Follow poll_after_seconds; do not spin. Returns measured usage and dashboard_path: open that local HTML in the host preview when available. Unknown quota is not zero; never call the local 30-call cap Google quota.

tools.name: highlight_results
tools.description: List verified clips, including partial ready results. Returns original-source times and artifact paths/resources; outputs may expire.

tools.name: highlight_revise
tools.description: Queue a new immutable revision of one clip using absolute ORIGINAL source times. Preserve original; requires expected_revision. Returns operation job_id.

tools.name: highlight_cancel
tools.description: Request cooperative cancellation. Does not delete files or reverse incurred provider charges.

tools.name: highlight_retry
tools.description: Explicitly resume failed, interrupted or waiting work from checkpoints. Uncertain provider outcomes may incur another charge; explain returned warnings. Duplicate retry of active work reuses it.

tools.name: highlight_settings
tools.description: Read sanitized settings/readiness. Never returns API key. Configure secrets outside chat via environment or local wizard. No provider test is performed.

tools.name: highlight_jobs
tools.description: List retained jobs, newest first, to recover progress after a chat closes.
